methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Virginia Tech researchers’ AI model is meant to manage water use
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech AI research for water management combined with #AppalachiaBuiltThis hands-on community build night in Abingdon signals grassroots technical capacity building in historically underserved regions—challenging the concentration narrative if sustained.

signals.title: Meta, Google invest in skilled worker training to build Virginia data centers - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Meta and Google investing in skilled worker training specifically to support Richmond-area data center construction deepens technical capacity but remains tethered to corporate infrastructure needs rather than distributed peer learning networks.

signals.title: How Fairfax County police are using AI — and why opponents are concerned - NBC4 Washington
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County police deploying AI tools demonstrates deep implementation capacity in NoVA but raises equity concerns—advanced capability concentrated in well-resourced jurisdictions while less-resourced regions lack even shallow adoption.

signals.title: How AI is changing what happens to Hampton Roads' trash - The Suffolk News-Herald
signals.signal_reading: AI managing Hampton Roads waste systems represents shallow, vendor-delivered automation that achieves operational efficiency without building local technical depth or transferable AI fluency in the workforce.

signals.title: Headlines from across the state: Virginia crabbers are helping map the bottom of the Chesapeake Bay; more …
signals.signal_reading: Richmond deploying a $52K AI assistant for non-emergency calls exemplifies platform-delivered shallow adoption—immediate utility without requiring deep technical capacity building in government workforce or broader community.
